description: A React component class for editing ad-hoc metrics within a popover UI, supporting multiple tabs (saved metrics, simple expressions, custom SQL), with resize and drag functionality, and integration with Superset's data and visualization utilities.

classes.name: AdhocMetricEditPopover
classes.description: A React PureComponent class providing a UI for editing ad-hoc metrics with tabbed interface, resize, and drag features.

methods.name: getDefaultTab
methods.description: Determines the default active tab based on current metric state and options.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles saving the current metric configuration and invoking the onChange callback.

methods.name: onResetStateAndClose
methods.description: Resets component state to initial props and closes the popover.

methods.name: onColumnChange
methods.description: Updates the metric when a different column is selected.

methods.name: onAggregateChange
methods.description: Updates the metric when a different aggregate is selected.

methods.name: onSavedMetricChange
methods.description: Loads a saved metric into the editor when selected.

methods.name: onSqlExpressionChange
methods.description: Updates the metric with a new SQL expression.

methods.name: onDragDown
methods.description: Initiates resize operation on mouse down.

methods.name: onMouseMove
methods.description: Handles resize operation during mouse move.

methods.name: onMouseUp
methods.description: Ends resize operation on mouse up.

methods.name: onTabChange
methods.description: Switches active tab and refreshes editor.

methods.name: renderColumnOption
methods.description: Renders a column option in the dropdown.

methods.name: renderMetricOption
methods.description: Renders a saved metric option in the dropdown.
